info.name: MCreator MCP Plus
info.author: McCreatorMCP
info.description: Extends the built-in MCreator MCP server with additional tools for building quality mods: workspace settings, localization, texture/sound/model/structure import, texture editing, element management, quality audit, history, export, screenshots and vanilla balancing reference. Can also run its own MCP server when the built-in one is disabled.
info.credits: Built on top of the MCreator MCP API
